name: stats-banner

frames.best_why: The headline has reached 500K+, every supporting figure is settled and the full banner and cards are visible.

tagline: One huge number on a hot gradient banner, over three counting stat cards.
summary: A dark metrics band with a heading and one wide banner showing a large total on an orange-pink gradient. Beneath it, three bordered cards count up smaller figures when the section comes into view.
appearance: Near-black page with a centred white heading, a small grey subtitle, then a wide rounded banner filled with a vivid orange, pink and red gradient holding an oversized white "500K+". Below it sit three dark rounded cards with thin borders, each with a big white figure and a small grey caption.
behaviour: Scrolling the section into view slides the blocks up and runs each number from zero to its target with an eased count. Hovering a lower card lifts it slightly, lights its border and deepens its shadow.
demo_content: Heading "Trusted by Thousands" with 500K+ campaigns, 300K+ ads, 140K+ campaigns and 100K+ customers.
search_phrases: numbers that count up on the page
big number on a gradient background
large total with smaller metrics below
use_when: A landing page needs a short proof-of-scale band with one headline number and three supporting metrics.
avoid_when: Every label and figure is hardcoded, and the banner photo is a fixed orange-red gradient that fights other palettes.
customise: Heading, subtitle and all four numbers with their captions are written in the file; the hero gradient image and accent colour need source edits.
weight_why: Four short count-ups and CSS hovers; nothing runs once the numbers settle.

a11y.note: Figures are plain spans rewritten each tick with no live region, so screen readers hear no final value; no reduced-motion check.

issues: Captions are small grey text on near-black cards, faint at a glance.
polish_why: Strong contrast between banner and cards with clean spacing; captions are small and faint.
title: Stats Banner
